tests.purpose: Distinguish a direct RA0/V031-to-receiver-TP6/V072 continuation from two separate nets.

interpretation: Why this pair: C25/RA0/V031 and TP6/R27/V072 are two signal branches whose onward routes disappear internally. TP6 is connected through R27 to the first receiver amplifier output, making it a concrete candidate for the filtered PIC input. This is a hypothesis, not a claimed wire. A near-probe result supports one net; a kilohm reading indicates a component path and must not be treated as continuity. OL rejects only this pair, not every possible route.
